class.name: SlugVector3D
class.brief_description: Draws a [SlugVector] (an SVG) in a 3D world with the Slug algorithm.
class.description: SlugVector3D draws the filled regions of a [SlugVector] directly from their Bézier outlines, so the image stays crisp at any distance, scale or angle. This makes it a good fit for diegetic HUDs, icons and signage. Each region keeps the fill color authored in the SVG, multiplied by [member modulate]. [member size] is the world-space height of the vector's bounding box, so the drawing scales to fit that height and its width follows the aspect ratio. SlugVector3D only works with the GLES3 rendering backend; under GLES2 or with a null/invalid [member vector], nothing is drawn.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], the vector always faces the camera, matching the camera's rotation instead of the node's.
The color multiplied onto every region's authored fill color.
The world-space height of the vector's bounding box. The width is derived from the SVG's aspect ratio.
